_about: Customer-concentration facts read by hand from each company's latest annual filing on 2026-09-24, each re-checked by an independent verifier against the filing on SEC EDGAR. 'pct' is the largest single customer's share of revenue; null where the filing discloses none. Display only: these describe how concentrated a company's revenue is, not a supply link.

NVDA.customer: Largest direct customer (unnamed); the second-largest was 14%
NVDA.quote: Direct Customers – For fiscal year 2026, sales to one direct customer represented 22% of total revenue and sales to another direct customer represented 14% of total revenue, all of which were primarily attributable to the Compute & Networking segment.

AMD.customer: No customer reached 10% of revenue in FY2025 or FY2024
AMD.quote: No customer accounted for at least 10% of the Company’s consolidated net revenue in fiscal years 2025 and 2024. One Client and Gaming segment customer accounted for 18 % of consolidated net revenue in fiscal year 2023.

QCOM.customer: Largest customer/licensee (unnamed); the 10-K names Apple, Samsung and Xiaomi as each 10% or more
QCOM.quote: Revenues from each customer/licensee that were 10% or greater of total revenues were as follows: 2025 2024 2023 Customer/licensee (x) 21 % 22 % 27 % Customer/licensee (y) 20 19 21 Customer/licensee (z) 13 12 * * Less than 10%

AVGO.quote: During fiscal years 2025, 2024 and 2023, one customer accounted for 32 %, 28 % and 21 % of our net revenue, respectively.

DELL.customer: One customer (unnamed), almost all Infrastructure Solutions Group sales
DELL.quote: One customer accounted for 12% of the Company's consolidated net revenue for the fiscal year ended January 30, 2026, with substantially all of such net revenue attributable to the sale of ISG offerings.

AAPL.customer: No single customer's share of net sales is disclosed
AAPL.quote: As of September 27, 2025, the Company had one customer that represented 10% or more of total trade receivables, which accounted for 12%.

TSLA.customer: No customer's share of revenue is disclosed
TSLA.quote: As of December 31, 2025 and 2024, no entity represented 10% or more of our total receivables balance.

TSMC.quote: Our largest customer in 2023, 2024 and 2025 accounted for 25%, 22% and 19% of our net revenue in the respective year.

ASML.quote: Total net sales to our largest customer amounted to €7,796.7 million, or 23.9% of total net sales in 2025, compared with €4,682.4 million, or 16.6% of total net sales in 2024.

SONY.quote: There were no sales with any single major external customer for the fiscal years ended March 31, 2024, 2025 and 2026.
